# Kernel drift

Status: PASS.

As in section 2b: bf16 base and logit backpropagation; float32 LoRA parameters and CPU gradient vectors; float32 chunked products accumulated in float64. Fits and drift metrics use float64.

The same question/token/context coordinates and parameter order as section 2b are used.

| Adapter | ‖KT−K0‖F / ‖K0‖F | Pearson(KT,K0) | New shared C: variance explained | Fixed C0: variance explained |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| owl | 6.71514159 | 0.152499244 | 0.376963103 | 0.336046649 |
| control | 7.14840036 | 0.324553818 | 0.815710792 | 0.541868345 |

Per-block scores use each block's own mean-centered denominator; negative fractions are retained and zero denominators are undefined. Shared matrices are fitted globally across all 100 blocks.
